name: feature-dev-codex
description: Module-by-module, reuse-first feature development workflow for Codex with human-reviewable plans and two approval gates.

interface.shortDescription: Split into modules, reuse first, review one readable plan.
interface.longDescription: A Codex-native five-step feature workflow: explore and split the requirement into modules, verify reuse of existing code and public practice per module, write a human-reviewable plan, implement module by module under the team's conventions, then review independently. Persistent planning files and two approval gates control key decisions.
defaultPrompt: Use feature-dev-codex to split this feature into modules and plan it.
Check existing code and public practice before designing.
Run a high-risk feature workflow with approval gates.
